KB Home

On the difficult backdrop, the S&P 500 Real Estate Index Sector (SP500-60) decreased 1.36% week-over-week to 266.46 points, while the accompanying State Street Real Estate Select Sector SPDR ETF
was down 2.28% to $41.56.
The Dow Jones REIT Indx Equity REIT Total Return Index declined 1.15%, while the FTSE Nareit All Equity REITs index retreated 1.18%.
Weekly Winners & Losers
Among largecap stocks, telecom tower REITs Crown Castle
(-7.14% W/W to $67.84) and SBA Communications
(-6.97% W/W to $166.15) led the losers.
Telecom tower REITs were recently slapped with bearish outlooks by investment banks on broader sector underperformance.
Meanwhile, Host Hotels & Resorts
led the gainers, adding 2.66% from the prior week to $22.42.
Welltower
followed with a 1.09% gain to $231.37. The week saw J.P. Morgan raise its recommendation on the stock to Overweight from Neutral, citing WELL trades at one of the lowest implied cap rates.
For midcap gainers, Howard Hughes
(+13.63% W/W to $68.43) led the pack.

Next week, Howard Hughes is set to host its annual shareholders meeting, which will include discussions on plans to accelerate transformation into a diversified holding company, including efforts to significantly reduce the capital intensity of Howard Hughes Communities, the company's real estate subsidiary, and increase capital available for investment in Vantage, the company's insurance subsidiary.
Medical Properties Trust
extended gains from the prior week, when it sold Idaho Falls Community Hospital and Mountain View Hospital for $413M. The stock closed 5.00% higher at $3.57.
Fermi
topped the losers in a week that saw the REIT and TensorWave amend their data center lease and services agreement to extend the closing date under the lease by a month.
Additionally, Fermi signed a management agreement with CBRE Group
to run and maintain building one, its first data center in the Texas Panhandle.
The stock fell 9.24% from the previous week to $4.52.
Compass
followed with a 6.94% decline to $9.38.
Among smallcap stocks, Adamas Trust
(-8.64% W/W to $8.14), TPG RE Finance Trust
(-8.64% W/W to $6.56), Transcontinental Realty Investors
(+6.35% W/W to $42.88), and Empire State Realty Trust
(+4.58% W/W to $4.11) were the notable movers.
